subject: TCP connection state machine

authored.protocol: source-first: the author agent read only RFC 9293 and never saw the .fd file

questions.ask: On the passive-open path, when a TCP in the LISTEN state receives a SYN from a remote peer, what state does it move to and what segment does it send in response?
questions.tests: passive-open transition out of LISTEN: destination state and the response action
questions.answer: It moves to SYN-RECEIVED and sends a SYN,ACK segment.

questions.ask: When a TCP performs an active OPEN starting from the CLOSED state, what state does it enter and what segment does it send?
questions.tests: active-open transition out of CLOSED: destination state and the action taken
questions.answer: It enters SYN-SENT, after creating the TCB, and sends a SYN segment.

questions.ask: A TCP that sent a SYN and is in the SYN-SENT state receives a SYN,ACK segment from the peer. What does it send back, and what state does the connection reach?
questions.tests: SYN-SENT to ESTABLISHED transition: triggering event, response action, resulting state
questions.answer: It sends an ACK and the connection enters the ESTABLISHED state.

questions.ask: If the local application issues a CLOSE while the connection is ESTABLISHED, what state does the connection move to and what segment does the TCP send?
questions.tests: locally-initiated (active) close: transition out of ESTABLISHED on local CLOSE
questions.answer: It moves to FIN-WAIT-1 and sends a FIN.

questions.ask: If a TCP in the ESTABLISHED state receives a FIN from the remote peer (the local side has not yet closed), what state does it move to and what does it send back?
questions.tests: remotely-initiated (passive) close: transition out of ESTABLISHED on receiving a FIN
questions.answer: It moves to CLOSE-WAIT and sends an ACK.

questions.ask: From the CLOSE-WAIT state, what event moves the connection to LAST-ACK, and what does the TCP send when that happens?
questions.tests: CLOSE-WAIT to LAST-ACK transition: triggering event (local CLOSE) and the action (send FIN)
questions.answer: A CLOSE call by the local user moves it to LAST-ACK, and the TCP sends a FIN.

questions.ask: If a TCP in FIN-WAIT-1 (having already sent its own FIN) receives a FIN from the remote peer before its own FIN has been acknowledged, what state does the connection move to?
questions.tests: simultaneous-close case: FIN-WAIT-1 to CLOSING transition, distinct from the FIN-WAIT-1 to FIN-WAIT-2 path
questions.answer: It moves to the CLOSING state (and sends an ACK for the received FIN).

questions.ask: How long must a TCP connection remain in the TIME-WAIT state before it transitions to CLOSED?
questions.tests: TIME-WAIT to CLOSED transition: the timeout duration that gates it
questions.answer: It must linger for a timeout of 2 MSL (twice the Maximum Segment Lifetime) before transitioning to CLOSED.
